answer_1.quote: We introduce a new explainable event likelihood prediction task (EEL) that requires models to provide a causal chain of events to support event likelihood predictions... our approach generates explanations as causal chains.
answer_1.outputs: Causal graphs, causal explanation chains, event likelihood predictions

answer_2.quote: We measured the performance of different approaches ... reporting balanced accuracy (BAcc) and Macro F1 ... For explanations we introduced three metrics: Causality, Informativeness, and Coherence.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4 for primitive questions ... to evaluate each causal relation between event pairs. Human scores are compared to GPT-4 ...

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is more trustworthy... we selected all test instances from 10 articles and provided human annotators (students) with their explanations. Human annotators are asked the same primitive evaluation question Can event "EVENT1" cause event "EVENT2"?.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked the primitive causal question: Can event "EVENT1" cause event "EVENT2"?
